Coronary artery disease develops when plaque gradually builds up inside the heart's arteries, narrowing them enough to cause chest pain, angina, or in more serious cases, a heart attack. Dr Kiran K Narang evaluates each patient thoroughly before any device-based intervention is considered. Angiography and angioplasty are related but distinct cardiac procedures — angiography is a diagnostic test that images the coronary arteries to identify blockages, while angioplasty is an intervention that uses a balloon catheter to open them. A 2D echocardiogram is an imaging test that shows the heart's muscles and valves moving in real time, without any radiation or invasive procedure. Dr Kiran K Narang conducts 2D echocardiography in Andheri East, Mumbai with findings assessed and explained thoroughly.
